page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Optimized3.Flex.18-72 is a compute-oriented virtual machine shape driven by an Intel Xeon 6354 processor operating at 3.0 GHz. Built upon x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 18 dedicated physical cores with multithreading enabled, supplying 36 vCPUs. The memory allocation is 72.0 GB, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio. This density favors instruction throughput over expansive memory footprints, maintaining dedicated execution without hypervisor-level core competition.

Hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs included on the platform. The instance does not bundle local NVMe storage, requiring all persistent storage and operating system volumes to attach via networked block storage services. A single complimentary public IPv4 address is provided for direct network access. Because local scratch disks are not present, workflows with severe local read and write demands rely entirely on network storage performance.

The qualitative profile of this server emphasizes CPU performance density per resource unit. It provides consistent clock execution for batch compute, code compilation pipelines, algorithmic modeling, and horizontally scaled web tier nodes. The primary tradeoff centers on memory limits and the lack of native ephemeral NVMe storage, making it unsuitable for large in-memory databases or workloads demanding extreme local input-output operations.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Optimized3.Flex.18-72 is a compute-focused virtual machine configured with 36 vCPUs across 18 dedicated physical cores using the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6354 processor at 3.0 GHz. The system provides 72.0 GB of memory, creating a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio tailored for compute-heavy applications that do not demand extensive RAM capacity. The platform excludes local solid-state drives and discrete GPUs, necessitating network-attached block volumes for data persistence. One complimentary public IPv4 address is included. Due to its dedicated CPU allocation and steady clock speeds, VM.Optimized3.Flex.18-72 functions effectively for parallel batch processing, software compilation clusters, data transformation tasks, and high-concurrency web serving workloads.
